name: abr-lookup
description: Look up Australian businesses on the Australian Business Register: ABN status, GST registration, charity (DGR) status, business names and location. Needs an access key from mySMB.

connection.instructions: Lookups use mySMB's own ABN Lookup registration. Paste the **ABR Lookup access key** mySMB issued to your workspace. A workspace admin can add it once under **Admin → Service connections**, so everyone's tiles, reports and automations use it without connecting individually; chat agents and mySidekick use each person's own connection.

fields.name: ABR_ACCESS_KEY
fields.label: ABR Lookup access key
fields.helpText: Issued by mySMB for your workspace. It isn't an ABR GUID: you don't need to register with the ABR.
